# Tiny Signal Club

> Tiny Signal Club makes small, interactive worlds from verified audience choices. People decide, tools assist, and people remain responsible for every release.

## Public interactive artifacts

- [Home](/): Project promise, premiere, and weekly rhythm.
- [Founding Day demo](/demo): A local decision-to-reveal loop that creates a versioned town artifact.
- [Tiny Internet Town](/town): The current public map and town memory.
- [Season One roadmap](/roadmap): Six planned episodes and their audience consequences.
- [How we make](/making): Human craft, AI boundaries, release proofs, disclosure guidance, and learning log.
- [Living playbook](/playbook): Launch work, Project One, growth, future concepts, rehearsal, and safety guardrails.
- [Future project map](/future): Ten bounded prototype ideas waiting for evidence, not announcements.

## Participation boundaries

- The protected site result is the authoritative vote result.
- Chat reactions never substitute for a verified vote.
- Participation is free; payment does not buy votes, ownership, moderation influence, or creative priority.
- Consequential synthetic media is disclosed, provenance is recorded, and the human operator remains accountable.
